title: Strategic Voting Axioms for Multiwinner Elections
abstract: arXiv:2609.37373v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We create a set of 6 axioms relating to strategic voting and study them on single transferable vote (STV), Meek STV, Bloc, Chamberlin-Courant, Monroe, and k-Borda. For Chamberlin-Courant, Monroe, and k-Borda, we implement ``optimistic'' and ``pessimistic'' models for handing incomplete ballots, thus turning each of the three into two separate voting rules. We determine which voting rules satisfy each axiom. We find that under Chamberlin-Courant and k-Borda, the optimistic models encourage burying, while the pessimistic models encourage truncation strategies, indicating that the handling of partial ballots has tremendous implications for strategic voting. We define an axiom called no skipped payment that differentiates similar rules, as Meek STV and Chamberlin-Courant satisfy it, while STV and Monroe fail. translated_title: 多胜者选举中的策略性投票公理
translated_abstract: 我们创建了一套与策略性投票相关的6条公理，并在可转移单票制（STV）、Meek STV、Bloc、Chamberlin-Courant、Monroe和k-Borda这几种投票规则上对它们进行研究。对于Chamberlin-Courant、Monroe和k-Borda，我们实现了处理不完整选票的“乐观”和“悲观”两种模型，从而将这三种规则各自变成两个独立的投票规则。我们确定了哪些投票规则满足每条公理。我们发现，在Chamberlin-Courant和k-Borda下，乐观模型会鼓励“埋没”策略，而悲观模型会鼓励“截断”策略，这表明对部分选票的处理方式对策略性投票有着巨大的影响。我们定义了一条称为“无跳过支付”的公理，该公理能够区分相似的规则：Meek STV和Chamberlin-Courant满足它，而STV和Monroe则不满足。我们还发现每种投票规则都无法满足“最爱背叛”公理，这表明它们都不能完全免疫策略性投票。总的来说（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了6条策略性投票公理并在多种多胜者投票规则上研究其满足情况，发现不完整选票的处理方式对策略性投票行为有重大影响，且没有任何一种规则能完全免受策略性投票的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes 6 strategic voting axioms and studies their satisfaction across multiple multiwinner voting rules, finding that the handling of partial ballots has tremendous implications for strategic voting and that none of the rules are completely immune to strategic manipulation.
